Target Com (TGT) Holder Greatmark Investment Partners Raised Holding by $6.67 Million; Sandy Spring Bank Position in Bce (BCE) Has Cut as Valuation Declined
June 1, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Greatmark Investment Partners Inc increased its stake in Target Corp Com (TGT) by 12082.5% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc bought 96,660 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.40% with the market. The institutional investor held 97,460 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.77 million, up from 800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Target Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $38.84B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.79% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $72.89. About 6.42 million shares traded or 14.39% up from the average. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 31.38% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.81% the S&P500.
Sandy Spring Bank decreased its stake in Bce Inc. (BCE) by 12.53% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sandy Spring Bank sold 11,944 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 83,373 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.59M, down from 95,317 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sandy Spring Bank who had been investing in Bce Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $37.70 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.00% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $41.67. About 795,681 shares traded. BCE Inc. (NYSE:BCE) has declined 6.78% since June 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.35% the S&P500.

Greatmark Investment Partners Inc, which manages about $285.51M and $274.46 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Bank Amer Corp Com (NYSE:BAC) by 10,733 shares to 262,620 shares, valued at $7.88M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1,952 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 82,343 shares, and cut its stake in Bed Bath & Beyond Inc Com (NASDAQ:BBBY).

BCE’s profit will be $642.31 million for 14.67 P/E if the $0.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.63 actual EPS reported by BCE Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 12.70% EPS growth.
